scope: Follow-up 9 regular-lab requested scenario; not complete original §19 acceptance or physical arm64 proof
title: Stale acknowledgement and observation authority
expected: After acceptance an unexpected heartbeat preserves versions/recovery, creates no seeding audit and withholds confirmation; before acceptance each unexpected job/release on the current job is audited exactly once; stale ACK replay never restores the older job or desired generation
actual: Fresh unexpected release audited once; accepted releases never seeded or audited by that path; mismatches withhold confirmation; stale ACK replay preserves the newer job

observations.detail:
[{"quote":"Heartbeats after acceptance can confirm those
values, but cannot change current/last-good or clear recovery.","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:480"},{"quote":"Once a result is accepted, seeding closes even for later jobs in that incarnation.","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:561"},{"quote":"A mismatch in
either release keeps `unconfirmed=true` by withholding that job's observation
timestamp; a later agreeing report can confirm it.","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:481"},{"quote":"A generation-bearing heartbeat is attributed to the **node's current job only**
(§13.2, §13.8; D-068, r13 M-1).","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:489"},{"quote":"Before that incarnation's first accepted result, pre-result heartbeat seeding
fills **only a null `nodes.current_release_id`**","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:509"},{"quote":"On the current job, each distinct unexpected release/job pair
gets one `update_observation.unexpected_release` audit","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:534"},{"quote":"A
later agreeing null last-good permits the issued target to fill the null
`current_release_id`, without establishing `last_good_release_id`.","source":"docs/updates/central-lifecycle.md:556"}]
